literal: "$n says, 'Thanks for helping clean this place up...'"
"$n tells you, 'A stamp costs %d coins.'\r\n$n tells you, '...which I see you can't afford.'"
"Without more coins, I can give no wisdom."
"You seem to have lost your prey.\r\n"
"A ray of flame bursts out of the object, consuming the undead!"
"That'll be %d coins, you should feel much better.. if you wake up."
"You don't have enough gold, get outta here!"
"Your blood freezes as you hear someone's death cry."
"$n dreams of running naked through a field of tulips."
"$n shivers and transforms out of werewolf form!"
"What do you want to do there?\r\n"
"But you are not the member of a group!\r\n"
"Sorry, but you cannot do that here!\r\n"
"$n loots some gold from the corpse of %s."
"You do not belong to a clan!\r\n"
"But you are not the member of a group!\r\n"
"Everyone following you here is already in your group.\r\n"
"Heh heh heh.. we are jolly funny today, eh?\r\n"
"$N is not in a proper position for that."
"$n says, 'You dirty rotten scoundrel.  I'm gonna make you very sorry.'"
" Get out of here before I call the guards!"
"$n chokes and utters some strange sounds."
"With a blinding flash of light and a crack of thunder, you are teleported..."
"  It vanishes in a puff of smoke!"
"You hit the ground with a thud.\r\n"
"You can't seem to find any %ss here.\r\n"
"You cannot promote someone over the top rank!\r\n"
"You are not holy enough to turn away the Undead!\r\n"
"You seem to have lost your prey.\r\n"
"$E is AFK right now, $E may not hear you."
"You tag $N, but $E tags you right back!\r\n"
"Your flesh is altered, you can't wield anything!\r\n"
"$n is zapped by $p and instantly lets go of it."
"The lunar light infuses your body, forcing you to transform!\r\n"
